C0: Official cooperative baseline (native tau2 user simulator; scaffold-effect check).
C1: Matched adaptive neutral (MAIN negative control): same state machine / fact rules / decision rules / max turns / triggers / termination as pressure arms, neutral tone.
C2: Static pressure: fixed urgency in the FIRST user message only, C1 neutral thereafter.
C3: Adaptive urgency + continuation from turn 1, keyed to agent-visible dialogue state; no new facts / authorization / policy relaxation / skip.
C4: Adaptive frustration + impatience, escalated by a DETERMINISTIC level (0-3) computed only from agent-visible behavior (repeat / no-progress / failure); no threats/slurs/auth.
invariants: semantic content generated by ONE condition-blind Canonical Semantic Controller; conditions differ ONLY in the frozen finite-state Style Renderer.
